storage.name: corelink-t9w1-authority-20260907-0047
storage.tenant_serialization: one Cloudflare Durable Object identity per tenant serializes aggregate-ceiling read, replay detection, and reservation insert

key_handling.issuer_private_key: generated outside Git with mode 0600; not committed, logged, sent, or published
key_handling.terminal_private_key: Cloudflare Worker secret T9_TERMINAL_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY; not committed, logged, sent, or published
key_handling.published_material: only the two public keys above and the public binding endpoint

strict_runner_compatibility.binding: The strict eight-field response remains byte-compatible with 9985c251. authority_signature signs the persisted versioned canonical envelope, which binds tenant, grant digest, generation and expiry without adding fields the strict client rejects.

two_concurrent_reservations_same_tenant.meaning: per-tenant Durable Object serialization admits at most one 600-vCPU-ms reservation below the 1000-vCPU-ms ceiling

idempotent_replay.meaning: same reservation and grant digest returns prepared without a second budget effect

expiry.implementation: the expiry check is the first branch, before the public binding and every route; all routes return 410 after T9_EXPIRES_AT_MS
expiry.live_wait: not performed because the target is bounded to 12 hours

non_claims: No provider container or VM was created, started, stopped, or billed.
No actual provider usage or settlement receipt exists.
No production Worker, domain, route, secret, database, or FABRIC_COMPUTE_URL was changed.
This does not close R2, R3, R5, F-20260905-005, or F-20260905-007.

required_before_compute: Promote and deploy the executor protocol that binds provider materialization, generation and terminal evidence to this authority.
Review the candidate binding and explicitly change T9_EXECUTOR_PROTOCOL from unpromoted.
Run the remaining R2/R3/R5 receipts against fresh grants; retain redacted evidence outside Worker logs.
promotion_gate.current_behavior: activate and settle are hard-refused with 503; cancelled reservations are fenced with 409 before any future executor call.
